snippet.title: Where Giants Fall - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Where Giants Fall on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4432710/

Where Giants Fall is a 3D top-down fantasy bullet-heaven action roguelite where fragile runs grow into screen-filling power.

Survive procedural fantasy biomes, upgrade auto-fire weapons, earn active abilities, unlock powerful ultimates, shut down Ritual Sieges, defeat giant bosses, and push your build as far as it can go in Endless Mode.

Every run starts small. Every upgrade pushes you closer to becoming the storm.

Coming to PC and Steam Deck.
